      printf 'COLLISION file source="%s" destination="%s"\n' "$src" "$dst" | tee -a "$report"

    fi
  else
    printf 'UNSUPPORTED source="%s"\n' "$src" | tee -a "$report"
  fi
done

command:
set -eu
root=/srv/legacy2/filename-encoding-migration
src=$root/imported
dst=$root/converted
latin_e=$(printf '\351')
utf8_e=$(printf '\303\251')
s_cafe=$src/caf${latin_e}.txt
s_resume=$src/r${latin_e}sum${latin_e}.txt
d_cafe=$dst/caf${utf8_e}.txt
d_resume=$dst/r${utf8_e}sum${utf8_e}.txt
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s kernel=' "$PRETTY_NAME"; uname -r

printf 'converted_count='; find "$dst" -type f | wc -l

printf 'destination_name_bytes:\n'; find "$dst" -mindepth 1 -print0 | od -An -v -tx1
for pair in "$s_cafe|$d_cafe|cafe" "$s_resume|$d_resume|resume"; do

  dhash=$(sha256sum "$2" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
